hero.description: NODUS was born with a simple idea: companies don't need more digital activity, they need results. We combine strategy, data, technology and execution to accelerate the growth of ambitious businesses.
hero.quoteCaption: The promise we keep with every client.

purpose.heading: Mission, vision and values
purpose.subheading: What drives us, where we're headed and how we work with every client, every day.
purpose.mission: To transform companies' potential into sustainable growth, integrating strategy, technology and digital capabilities that accelerate their development, strengthen their competitive positioning and enable them to reach new levels of scalability and leadership in their markets.
purpose.vision: To be an international benchmark in corporate growth partnering, building a strategic ecosystem of solutions and capabilities that drives the digital evolution of hundreds of companies in Latin America and North America, and helps consolidate them as leaders in their respective industries.

values.title: Analytical rigor
values.description: No room for intuition or passing fads. Every campaign, line of code and automation answers a measurable conversion goal.

values.title: Transparency and absolute ownership
values.description: Ad accounts, accesses and databases are 100% yours from day one. We deliver real-time dashboards and clear reports with no evasive jargon.

values.title: Agility and continuous iteration
values.description: We implement and test in cycles of days and weeks, not stagnant quarterly reviews. We optimize on the fly to protect and maximize your budget.

values.title: Incentive alignment
values.description: We operate as a high-performance in-house execution arm. Our retention doesn't depend on a legal lock-in clause, but on the real benefit and value we create every month.

philosophy.heading: We don't offer posts, we deliver strategy, results and growth.
philosophy.subheading: We're not a traditional vendor selling posts and “digital activity”. We're a growth partner: we measure, iterate and scale what delivers results.

points.title: Business metrics vs. Vanity metrics
points.description: A “like” doesn't pay payroll. We prioritize metrics that impact the business: cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS) and qualified lead generation.

points.title: Integrated ecosystems vs. Isolated content
points.description: An optimized ad campaign won't convert if the website is slow or the technical infrastructure fails. We connect every link in the funnel to ensure performance.

points.title: Impact deliverables vs. Hourly billing
points.description: We don't charge for the time it takes us to design; we charge for the technical and operational performance we leave implemented every month.

points.title: Growth partners vs. Passive vendors
points.description: We're not a disconnected vendor; we focus on guaranteeing a constant flow of highly qualified traffic and optimizing your digital channels, defending the profitability of your investment.

philosophy.quote: We don't sell tasks and promises: we implement a measurable, scalable acquisition system backed by measurable data.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about the monthly plan, the investment, the guarantee and the ownership of your digital assets.

items.question: How does the monthly plan work?
items.answer: Each month we run a continuous cycle of diagnosis, planning, execution, optimization and reporting under the ARR methodology. The team works toward clear objectives and you decide when to adjust or scale the scope based on your business priorities.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment or long-term contract?
items.answer: No. We work month to month with no lock-in clauses. If you decide to cancel, you only need to notify us before the next cycle starts. We hand over full ownership of the documentation, digital assets and developed code to guarantee your company's continuity.

items.question: Does the plan cost include the advertising budget and tools?
items.answer: No. The monthly plan covers our team's strategy, execution, development and optimization. Ad budgets (Meta, Google) and software licenses (CRM, servers) are paid directly to the platforms in your company's name.

items.question: Do the accounts, developments and databases stay in my name?
items.answer: 100% yes. All ad accounts, web code access (Next.js), CRM databases and automations are the exclusive property of your company from day one.

items.question: How do we manage communication if we're in different countries or time zones?
items.answer: We work with agile methodologies, keep fluid communication through WhatsApp for day-to-day matters, real-time dashboards to track progress, and strategy sessions by video call scheduled in your local time zone.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: You'll see the audit and action plan in the first week. The first measurable results arrive between the first and second month: optimized ads, active funnels and conversion improvements on your website.

items.question: What does the first week include?
items.answer: A full audit of your digital presence, competitive analysis, KPI definition and an actionable monthly plan. By the end of the week you'll know exactly what we're going to do and why.

items.question: What guarantee do you offer on deliverables?
items.answer: Compliance and scope guarantee: at the start of each cycle we approve a work plan with KPIs and precise dates. If an agreed deliverable is not met, it is compensated in the next cycle or not billed. We also review the results together in a monthly call before renewing.

items.question: Who executes the plan?
items.answer: A dedicated team: strategist, paid media specialist, developer and automation expert. We work with shared tools so you can see progress in real time, with no intermediaries.

items.question: Do you work with our in-house team?
items.answer: Yes, it's our favorite way to work. We integrate with your team, document processes and train you so you depend less on us over time and can grow with our tools.
